title: Chapter 10 — Election Season
description: Iya Bọ́sẹ̀'s deadline, Baba Ticket's succession, Settlement's final offer, the biggest rally.

cards.title: Act 4 — The Reckoning
cards.text: Day {stat:day}. Three days to the election. Every wall in Iyana-Wahala has two faces on it, and both are smiling at you.

beats.headline: THREE DAYS TO GO
beats.text: Hon. Owó Ńlá promises "stomach infrastructure". Hon. Mrs. Ronke Ademola-Peters promises "jollof with dignity". The Independent Ballot Commission promises to "try".

beats.speaker: iyaBose
beats.text: (voice note) {name}. This is Iya Bọ́sẹ̀. The women have seen your alerts. We are not happy. But we are... less unhappy. Continue.

beats.speaker: mama
beats.text: {name}, Iya Bọ́sẹ̀ greet me for market today. GREET ME. I almost fainted.

beats.speaker: iyaBose
beats.text: (voice note) {name}. Community meeting is on Saturday. Your mother will stand in front of everybody. Unless you have something to say with numbers.

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: (Mama's debt: {debt}. Hustle savings: {hustleMoney}.)

options.text: Send all your hustle savings home now.

beats.speaker: babaTicket
beats.text: (eating, slower than before) I don old. After election, I go announce who go sit for this chair. The monkey wey no get tail... no. The chair wey no get monkey... Hm. You understand me.

beats.speaker: babaTicket
beats.text: Scatter want am. Some people say you want am. Talk true.

beats.speaker: babaTicket
beats.text: Who go sit for this chair after me?

options.text: "Make the co-op run the park. Fair fee, receipts."
"Give am Scatter. I no want wahala."

beats.speaker: settlement
beats.text: My friend. Final offer of the season. Election day, the Iyana-Wahala polling unit. A ballot box will need... protection. Somebody to carry it somewhere safe. Very safe. Where nobody can count it.

beats.speaker: settlement
beats.text: Three hundred thousand naira. Half before, half after. No problem that money cannot settle.

beats.speaker: settlement
beats.text: I know you played games with me before. I am offering anyway. I believe in second chances. And in leverage.

beats.speaker: settlement
beats.text: Your answer?

options.lockedText: You need someone you trust to give the recording to

beats.speaker: ada
beats.text: Election wahala don start. Go and send money to your mama before somebody steals it. My POS dey here.

beats.speaker: ada
beats.text: You told me the truth about the Shell when you could have lied. That's why this door is still open.

beats.speaker: ada
beats.text: "Yellow dey in season." (She doesn't laugh.) It's been in season for a year now.

beats.speaker: ada
beats.text: You told me you were running from poverty. You were running from ₦850,000. I found out. Lagos is small.

beats.speaker: ada
beats.text: You carried my cartons the first day without anybody asking. I keep forgetting that, then remembering.

beats.speaker: ada
beats.text: First day, you bought bread and walked out without hello. Look at us now.

beats.speaker: ada
beats.text: And {name}... whatever Settlement gave you, I can smell it from here. Be careful.

beats.speaker: ada
beats.text: (she doesn't look up from her counting) We're closed. For you, we're closed.

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: (This is probably the last time she'll listen.)

options.text: "Ada. I was wrong. I'm sorry. Properly sorry."

beats.speaker: ada
beats.text: ...Properly sorry. (She almost smiles.) Okay. Buy something. Sorry no dey pay rent.

beats.objective: Last hustle before the election. (Ada's Corner can send money home.) The FEP mega-rally starts at 4 p.m. on the Roundabout road.

cards.title: The Mega-Rally
cards.text: Twenty buses of supporters. A stage. Rice bags with Owó Ńlá's face on them, stacked like a pyramid of himself.

beats.speaker: owoNla
beats.text: IYANA-WAHALA! Forward ever! (Crowd: BACKWARD SOMETIMES!) Vote for me and every one of you go chop! Some of you more than others! HA HA!

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Your phone is still recording. On stage, Owó Ńlá thanks "Barrister Settlement and the boys who will protect our ballot boxes on Saturday". By name.

beats.speaker: garba
beats.text: (at the tea table) Tomorrow, Operation Clean Sweep. Task Force from three local governments. Bassey get new boss. Everybody dey hide something tonight.

beats.title: End of Chapter 10 — Election Season
beats.summary: Mama's debt {debt}. Money {money}. Tomorrow the sweep begins.
